title: Transcriptomic profiling of placenta accreta and low-lying placenta using maternal plasma, urine, and peripheral blood
description: This project investigates transcriptomic alterations associated with placenta accreta (PA) and low-lying placenta (LLP) using RNA sequencing of maternal biofluids. Plasma, urine, and peripheral blood samples were collected from pregnancies complicated by PA, LLP, and gestationally matched healthy controls. High-throughput RNA sequencing was performed to identify differentially expressed genes and pathway-level changes associated with abnormal placentation. This dataset provides a multi-biofluid transcriptomic resource for understanding molecular mechanisms underlying invasive placentation and for identifying potential non-invasive biomarkers.
